spec.description: Dane zbierane z REST API Barracuda CloudGen Firewall przez Zabbix (itemy z tagiem type:API).

spec.rawSql: select h.host as "Host", regexp_replace(i.name, '^Box status ', '') as "Check", (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as "State" from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf%' and (i.name like 'Box status %' or i.name = 'Root disk state' or i.name ~ '^Service .* state$') order by 1, 2

select h.host as "Host", regexp_replace(i.name, '^Host ', '') as "Property", (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as "Value" from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf_box%' and i.name in ('Host appliance','Host hostname','Host hypervisor','Host model','Host release','Host timezone') order by 1, 2

with v as (select h.host, substring(i.name from '^S2S tunnel (.*): ') as tunnel, substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') as attr, case when i.value_type = 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) else (select hu.value::text from history_uint hu where hu.itemid = i.itemid order by hu.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type in (3,4) and i.key_ like 'cgf_vpn.s2s.%' and i.name like 'S2S tunnel %') select host as "Host", tunnel as "Tunnel", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Status') as "Status", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Sessions'))::int as "Sessions", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Peer address') as "Peer", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Local address') as "Local", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Encryption') as "Encryption", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Authentication') as "Auth", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Transport') as "Transport", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Type') as "Type" from v group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

with v as (select h.host, substring(i.name from '^Interface (.*): ') as ifname, substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') as attr, (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf_if.%') select host as "Host", ifname as "Interface", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Link state') as "Link", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Interface type') as "Type", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Duplex mode') as "Duplex", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Link negotiation') as "Negotiation" from v group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

spec.rawSql: with v as (select h.host, case when i.key_ like 'cgf_disk_root%' then '/' else substring(i.name from '^Filesystem (.*): ') end as fs, case when i.key_ = 'cgf_disk_root_state' then 'State' when i.key_ = 'cgf_disk_root_free' then 'Free space' else substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') end as attr, case i.value_type when 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) when 3 then (select hu.value::text from history_uint hu where hu.itemid = i.itemid order by hu.clock desc limit 1) else (select round(hf.value::numeric)::text from history hf where hf.itemid = i.itemid order by hf.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type in (0,3,4) and (i.key_ like 'cgf_disk.%' or i.key_ like 'cgf_disk_root%')) select host as "Host", fs as "Mountpoint", max(val) filter (where attr = 'State') as "State", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Free space'))::bigint as "Free space", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Free inodes'))::bigint as "Free inodes" from v group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

spec.title: Licenses & subscriptions
spec.description: Dni do wygaśnięcia: 99999 oznacza brak daty wygaśnięcia.

spec.rawSql: with v as (select h.host, case when i.key_ like 'cgf_license.%' then 'License' else 'Subscription' end as kind, substring(i.name from '^(?:License|Subscription) (.*): [^:]+$') as nm, substring(i.name from ': ([^:]+)$') as attr, case i.value_type when 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) else (select round(hf.value::numeric)::text from history hf where hf.itemid = i.itemid order by hf.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags = 4 and i.value_type in (0,4) and (i.key_ like 'cgf_license.%' or i.key_ like 'cgf_subscription.%')) select host as "Host", kind as "Kind", nm as "Name", max(val) filter (where attr = 'State') as "State", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Status') as "Status", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Days until expiry'))::bigint as "Days left" from v group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1, 2, 3

select count(*) filter (where val is distinct from 'UP') as "down" from (select (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.key_ like 'cgf_vpn.s2s.status%') v
